acceptance: drop (the MCP tool and TrackerService.drop) requires reason: non-empty after stripping, at most 2000 characters, newlines and tabs allowed, other control characters and U+0085/U+2028/U+2029 refused; a missing or blank reason is refused with E_STATE and the item is unchanged; covered by tests

A successful drop sets status dropped in index.json and drop_reason in items/<id>.json in exactly one state commit; a test asserts the branch advanced by one commit, and a publication retry after a competing push stores the reason once
show_item (MCP) and todo-db show return drop_reason for dropped items, including in the slim fallback forced by the byte cap; list_items rows are unchanged
validate_snapshot accepts dropped items without drop_reason and rejects a drop_reason that is not a non-empty string; SCHEMA_VERSION stays 3

scripts/mcp_snapshots/tools.json, the drop line in instructions.py, the README terms and CHANGELOG [Unreleased] are updated; the CHANGELOG lists the required parameter under Changed as a breaking tool-input change; the startup budget in test_mcp_slim.py rises only by the measured increase, with a comment
The PR is merged to joeharris76/todo-db main with CI green (uv run pytest -q, uv run ruff check .)

description:
drop (todo-db mcp/tools.py:376-389, service.py:1257-1265, store.py:2123-2159) takes only the id and an optional generation. Agents therefore write the reason with a separate update_item context_append and then drop: two state commits per drop. On 2026-10-30, 19 BenchBox items were dropped that way.

Three things go wrong. If the reason is skipped, there is none. If the drop fails after the note, the item stays open with a note saying it was dropped. If the note step is re-run, the note is duplicated (rollback-gates-on-pre-allowlist-removal-artifacts-20261029 got the same sentence in 30448aa0ca and 64909ab3d4).

Add a required reason to drop, stored in the item detail as drop_reason in the same commit. Follow the no-schema-bump pattern of ADR 0009 and ADR 0010: older clients load and keep the key. Reasons in practice run about 500 characters across lines, so the single-line 280-character session reason used by takeover does not fit; use the deferral-reason rules. Existing dropped items without a reason stay valid; clients older than this change can still drop without one until upgraded. list_items rows stay brief (600-token page cap). Open todo-db PR #47 adds blocked_reason, an 8 KiB cap and E_SECRET scanning; whichever lands second brings drop_reason under them. The same two-write pattern in finish is out of scope.
